chunks: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn 'Uqda al-Shaybani al-Kufi, he is from the Zaydis, however his hadith come in the hadith of our companions.

key_terms.أصحابنا: Our companions, referring to the primary Shia narrators
key_terms.الزيدية: Zaydis, a sect of Shia Islam

ai.seo_question: Is Ibn 'Uqda considered a reliable narrator despite being Zaydi?
ai.summary: This entry identifies Ibn 'Uqda as a Zaydi (a branch of Shia Islam) but notes that his narrations are accepted and included in the collections of the Shia scholars' companions.
